questions.question: At which ground did Iinyathi record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — highest total of 162, against Heat on 2015/10/18.

questions.question: St George's Park hosted South Africa Women's first-ever Test in December 1960. How many years passed before it hosted its first women's ODI?
questions.explanation: St George's Park didn't host a Women's ODI until South Africa played Ireland there in December 2025, 65 years later, making it the last of South Africa's major Test venues to do so.

questions.question: How many wicketkeeping dismissals separate the all-time #1 (Trisha Chetty) and #2 (Yolandi van der Westhuizen) wicketkeepers (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Trisha Chetty: 113 — Yolandi van der Westhuizen: 111 — a gap of 2.

questions.question: Lizelle Lee set a database record (13/14 season, T20) with a value of 355. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Runs', held by Lizelle Lee.

questions.question: At Kimberley Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Michaela van Vuuren holds it with 16.
